content.short: Oobit is a tap-to-pay app for spending Bitcoin, stablecoins and crypto at over 150 million card merchants.
content.description: Oobit is a Tether-backed crypto payments app that lets people spend Bitcoin, stablecoins and other crypto in everyday life through a tap-to-pay experience. Much like Apple Pay, users tap their phone at any Visa or Mastercard terminal and Oobit converts crypto to fiat in real time, so merchants receive normal payments while users spend from their own balances. It supports assets including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and its OOB token across networks such as BNB Chain, VeChain and TON, and adds features like sending crypto to a bank, corporate cards and agent cards with spending controls. Accepted at more than 150 million merchants worldwide, Oobit makes crypto usable for regular spending.
